name: Fox Fire
main_effect: [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the hand. If you have a Digimon with [Gabumon] or [Garurumon] in its name, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest level to the hand instead.
